import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_N = 10;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static int[][] matrix = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];

    static int add_mod(int a, int b) {
        a += b;
        return a >= MOD ? a - MOD : a;
    }

    static int sub_mod(int a, int b) {
        a -= b;
        return a < 0 ? a + MOD : a;
    }

    static int mul_mod(int a, int b) {
        return (int)((a * 1L * b) % MOD);
    }

    static int pow_mod(int a, int n) {
        if (n == 0) return 1;
        int half = pow_mod(a, n / 2);
        half = mul_mod(half, half);
        return (n & 1) != 0 ? mul_mod(half, a) : half;
    }

    static int inv_mod(int a) {
        return pow_mod(a, MOD - 2);
    }

    static int div_mod(int a, int b) {
        return mul_mod(a, inv_mod(b));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int val = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                matrix[i][j] = div_mod(val, 100);
            }
        }

        List<Pair<Set<Integer>, Integer>> sets = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Pair<Set<Integer>, Integer>> newSets = new ArrayList<>();
        Set<Integer> baseSet = new HashSet<>();
        baseSet.add(0);
        sets.add(new Pair<>(baseSet, 1));

        for (int g = 0; g < n; g++) {
            newSets.clear();
            int totalMasks = 1 << n;
            for (int mask = 0; mask < totalMasks; mask++) {
                int val = 1;
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    if (((mask >> j) & 1) != 0) {
                        val = mul_mod(val, matrix[j][g]);
                    } else {
                        val = mul_mod(val, sub_mod(1, matrix[j][g]));
                    }
                }
                for (Pair<Set<Integer>, Integer> p : sets) {
                    Set<Integer> currentSet = new HashSet<>();
                    for (int m2 : p.first) {
                        int possible = (~m2) & mask;
                        while (possible != 0) {
                            int pos = possible & (-possible);
                            currentSet.add(m2 | pos);
                            possible ^= pos;
                        }
                    }
                    if (currentSet.isEmpty()) continue;
                    List<Integer> list = new ArrayList<>(currentSet);
                    Collections.sort(list);
                    // Remove duplicates if any (though set ensures uniqueness)
                    Set<Integer> uniqueSet = new HashSet<>(list);
                    newSets.add(new Pair<>(uniqueSet, mul_mod(p.second, val)));
                }
            }
            // Sort newSets based on the set
            newSets.sort(Comparator.comparing(p -> p.first));
            sets.clear();
            int i = 0;
            while (i < newSets.size()) {
                int j = i;
                int sumVal = 0;
                while (j < newSets.size() && newSets.get(j).first.equals(newSets.get(i).first)) {
                    sumVal = add_mod(sumVal, newSets.get(j).second);
                    j++;
                }
                sets.add(new Pair<>(newSets.get(i).first, sumVal));
                i = j;
            }
        }

        int result = 0;
        for (Pair<Set<Integer>, Integer> p : sets) {
            result = add_mod(result, p.second);
        }
        System.out.println(result);
    }

    static class Pair<F, S> {
        F first;
        S second;

        Pair(F f, S s) {
            this.first = f;
            this.second = s;
        }
    }
}
